description: This file contains utility functions for checking the installed TensorFlow version, including functions to retrieve the version, verify if it meets minimum requirements, and assert or check the version with error handling.

methods.name: tf_version
methods.description: Retrieves the current TensorFlow version as a tuple of (major, minor, patch).

methods.name: tf_version_ok
methods.description: Checks if the current TensorFlow version is greater than or equal to the minimum required version and not blacklisted.

methods.name: assert_tf_version
methods.description: Asserts that the TensorFlow version meets the minimum requirements; raises an AssertionError if not.

methods.name: check_tf_version
methods.description: Checks the TensorFlow version and prints an error message and exits if the version is not up to date.
